about_p1: At Nizam Abdullayev Dental Clinic, we combine modern dental technologies with innovative treatment approaches to provide patients of all ages with healthy, natural and aesthetically pleasing smiles.
about_p2: With a strong focus on patient comfort, trust and satisfaction, we offer comprehensive dental care across a wide range of services, including general dentistry, oral and maxillofacial surgery, restorative treatments, aesthetic dentistry and personalized smile design.
about_p3: We carefully evaluate each patient's individual needs and plan every stage of the treatment process with precision, aiming to achieve long-lasting, functional and aesthetically refined results.
digital_big_desc: Most cases are scanned, not moulded — a traditional impression is only used on the rare occasions it's genuinely needed. Your new smile is previewed with AI-assisted design before treatment begins.
transfer_big_desc: A private, air-conditioned vehicle meets you at the airport, and your coordinator keeps you updated on your transfer and treatment stages.
lifetime_desc: Implants and zirconium restorations are covered by our lifetime warranty.
routing_desc: Your questions reach the specialist who handles them — surgical questions go to our surgeon, prosthetic questions to our prosthodontist.
special_care: Extra care for elderly patients and those with diabetes — protocols are adapted to your health profile. Ask your coordinator for details.

proc1_desc: A full arch of fixed teeth supported by just four implants, placed and restored in a single visit.
proc2_desc: Full-contour crowns and bridges milled from a single block of zirconia — strong, chip-resistant and precise.
proc3_desc: Implant restorations secured with an occlusal screw rather than cement, so they can be accessed and maintained without damage.
proc4_desc: Reshaping of the gum line to improve both the health and the appearance of your smile.
proc5_desc: Adds bone volume to the upper jaw when needed, giving implants in the back teeth a stable, lasting foundation.

rootcanal_desc: Removes infection from inside the tooth and seals it, saving the natural tooth wherever possible.
result_title: The result: patients who leave smiling
result_desc: From your first message to the flight home, our goal is simple — a healthier, more confident smile you're proud to show.
accommodation_desc: We work with hotels close to the clinic, so your stay is booked and confirmed before you even land.
faq1_q: How much can I save compared to UK, EU or US prices?
faq1_a: Most patients save a significant amount compared to Western Europe, the UK and the US for the same materials and techniques. Your exact quote depends on your treatment plan — send your case for a free, fixed price.
faq2_q: How long do I need to stay in Istanbul?
faq2_a: It depends on your treatment. Veneers, crowns and whitening are usually finished within 3–7 days. Implant cases may need a shorter first visit for surgery, then a second visit months later once healing is complete.
faq3_a: Most procedures are done under local anaesthesia, and sedation is available on request for anxious patients. Some mild soreness afterwards is normal and manageable with standard pain relief.
faq4_q: What happens if I need a check-up after I'm home?
faq4_a: Your treatment includes a written warranty and remote check-ins with your coordinator. For anything requiring an in-person look, we'll guide you on next steps.
faq5_q: Do I pay anything before I travel?
faq5_a: No. Your consultation and treatment plan are free, and nothing is charged until you decide to proceed — see the "How it works" section above.
privacy_p1: We collect the information you share with us — your name, contact details, and any photos or X-rays you send — only to prepare your treatment plan and coordinate your care.
privacy_p2: Your health information is treated as confidential and is only shared with the clinical team involved in your treatment. We do not sell or share your data with third parties for marketing purposes.
privacy_p3: You can ask us at any time to access, correct or delete your information by contacting us via WhatsApp or the details above.
